evals.prompt: Write the feature PRD for 'monthly invoice generation' from the usage-based-billing epic (epic.md and arch.md are in docs/ways-of-work/plan/usage-based-billing/).
evals.expected_output: A feature PRD saved to docs/ways-of-work/plan/usage-based-billing/monthly-invoice-generation/prd.md with user stories and acceptance criteria.
expectations: The Epic section links to the parent epic.md and arch.md
User Stories follow the format 'As a <persona>, I want to <action> so that I can <benefit>'
Each user story or major requirement has acceptance criteria as a checklist or Given/When/Then
The document has an Out of Scope section

evals.prompt: Feature PRD for 'export to CSV' in web-app.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks which epic the feature belongs to and what the user problem is before writing, since no parent epic or context was given.
expectations: The agent asks for the parent epic or searches docs/ways-of-work/plan/ for one before writing
The agent asks at least one clarifying question about the problem or target users
No prd.md is written with an empty Epic section

evals.prompt: Feature PRD for 'region selector at signup' under the data-residency epic in acme. The only persona is a workspace admin. Edge cases matter: a region that is at capacity, and a user who changes region after creating data.
evals.expected_output: A feature PRD with user stories that cover both named edge cases and functional requirements that address them.
expectations: User Stories include at least one story for a region at capacity and one for changing region after data exists
User Personas names the workspace admin as the target user
Functional Requirements are written as a bulleted list of specific system behaviours
